data.title: The flag that is one word short
story: Kak Dimas wrote a function that builds a practice flag from a list of word pieces. Its printed result looks convincing, but the test fails.
Trace the code, fix one obvious bug in the console, run it, then type the flag.

artifacts.label: flag.py
Test from Kak Dimas
artifacts.content: The flag must use ALL the pieces, in order, separated by _. Number of words in the flag = number of pieces (4).

explanation: range(1, len(items)) starts at index 1, so the first piece (index 0) is skipped. With range(len(items)) all four words are included, and the word-count test helps catch a bug whose output looks reasonable.
hints: Count the words in the printed result. Are there 4?
List indexes start at 0. Which number does the loop start from?
